ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there are four candidate graphs, labeled (A), (B), (C), (D). The vertical axis of each graph is log(n) (cm^-3), and the horizontal axis of each graph is 1/T (K^-1), therefore moving horizontally to the right indicates that 1/T increases and temperature T decreases. Graph (A) is high on the left side, then descends to a middle plateau, and on the right side falls downward again; graph (B) is basically a horizontal line; graph (C) has a plateau in the middle and falls downward on the right side, but the left side does not have the rising high value of the high-temperature intrinsic region; graph (D) is an oblique straight line from upper left to lower right. Reasoning: The free electron concentration of non-degenerately doped n-type silicon usually has three regions as temperature changes: at high temperature, intrinsic excitation is significant and n is relatively large; at medium temperature, donors are basically completely ionized, and n is approximately equal to the donor concentration, forming a plateau; at low temperature, the freeze-out effect occurs, donor ionization decreases, and n decreases. Since the horizontal axis is 1/T, high temperature is on the left side and low temperature is on the right side, so the correct curve should show a high value on the left side, a middle plateau, and a decline on the right side. Only graph (A) conforms to this feature.

method.method_draft: First inspect the axes and candidate shapes: all plots show log(n) on the vertical axis and 1/T on the horizontal axis, with diagram labels A–D. Then apply the three expected regions: high T intrinsic increase on the left, mid-T donor-ionized plateau, and low-T freeze-out decrease on the right. Select the only plot showing high-left value, middle plateau, and right-side fall: diagram A.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中有四个候选图，标为(A)、(B)、(C)、(D)。每个图的纵轴都是 log(n)（cm^-3），横轴都是 1/T（K^-1），因此横向向右表示 1/T 增大、温度 T 降低。图(A)在左侧高处，随后下降到中间平台，右侧又向下跌落；图(B)基本是一条水平线；图(C)中间为平台，右侧向下跌落，但左侧没有高温本征区的上升高值；图(D)是一条从左上到右下的斜直线。
推理：非简并掺杂 n 型硅的自由电子浓度随温度通常有三个区域：高温时本征激发显著，n 较大；中等温度时施主基本完全电离，n 约等于施主浓度，形成平台；低温时发生冻结效应，施主电离减少，n 降低。由于横轴是 1/T，高温在左侧，低温在右侧，所以正确曲线应表现为左侧高值、中间平台、右侧下降。只有图(A)符合这一特征。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For non-degenerately doped n-type silicon, increasing temperature moves leftward on a 1/T axis.
